brief.title: Train deterministic k-means++ Voronoi cells and residual product-quantization codebooks
brief.plain_summary: Partition dense vectors across nlist coarse centroids with k-means++, train M subspace residual codebooks of K_sub centroids and store compact M-byte uint8 PQ codes in inverted lists.
brief.outcome: Fitted IVF-PQ index and exact byte compression ratios vs float64 and float32 vectors.

Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.
